description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Message interface, representing a message with headers, payload, metadata, and optional response handling within a messaging framework, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableMessage
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Message interface, handling message headers, payload, metadata, and response consumer, for the Eclipse Ditto messaging framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating instances of ImmutableMessage, with optional response consumer.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload data.

methods.name: getRawPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing a clone of the raw payload ByteBuffer.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the extra JSON data.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the response consumer.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the message direction (inbound or outbound).

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing entity related to the message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the message.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the feature ID.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the content type.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timeout duration.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timestamp of the message.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the correlation ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the HTTP status code.
